minimum_qualification: Published Tamil writer, dialogue editor or equivalent demonstrated screen/performance-language practice
conflict_or_disqualifier: Authorship or production interest that cannot be declared and managed
preferred_review_mode: Line-by-line review plus actor-facing table read
acceptance_evidence: Accepted scope; Tamil competence; dated response; scene-level findings

minimum_qualification: Demonstrated scholarship or textual editing concerning Bharathidasan or modern Tamil literary adaptation
evidence_access_required: Lawfully held printed edition or reliable page images of Manimekalai Venpa
conflict_or_disqualifier: Reliance on OCR alone for exact wording
acceptance_evidence: Edition identified; page locators; direct versus interpretive findings

minimum_qualification: Classical Tamil scholar or editor with direct Manimekalai expertise
evidence_access_required: Primary Tamil edition and identified translation used by the project
conflict_or_disqualifier: Treating a later retelling as the primary epic
acceptance_evidence: Edition identified; source classifications; affected IDs

minimum_qualification: Scholar of Buddhist doctrine with capacity to review the Tamil or South Asian context
evidence_access_required: Philosophy bible and source-linked screenplay material
conflict_or_disqualifier: Generic spirituality review without doctrinal competence
acceptance_evidence: Causation, rebirth, renunciation and liberation findings

minimum_qualification: Scholar of Indian philosophy, epistemology or logic familiar with represented schools
conflict_or_disqualifier: Sectarian advocacy that will not review rival schools in strongest form

minimum_qualification: Historian or archaeologist of early South India
conflict_or_disqualifier: Projecting later imperial or modern institutions without evidence

minimum_qualification: Researcher of Tamil or South Indian food history and material practice
evidence_access_required: Aadhirai source passages, food dossier and Scenes 31-34
conflict_or_disqualifier: Modern recipe reconstruction presented as exact ancient fact
acceptance_evidence: Food-term ranges; visual cautions; serving-action findings

minimum_qualification: Dramaturg, historian or scholar with demonstrated consent-sensitive narrative practice
evidence_access_required: Character bibles and pursuit, grief and custody scenes
conflict_or_disqualifier: Romanticising persistence or assigning women responsibility for male violence
acceptance_evidence: Scene-level consent, agency and accountability findings

minimum_qualification: Trauma-informed dramaturg, performer or clinical adviser working within narrative ethics
evidence_access_required: Sudhamathi, Madhavi, Manimekalai and confinement scenes
conflict_or_disqualifier: Demanding disclosure or spectacle as proof of trauma
acceptance_evidence: Trigger and staging cautions; actor-facing notes; exclusions

minimum_qualification: Maritime archaeologist or Indian Ocean historian
evidence_access_required: Puhar, voyage and Manipallavam dossiers plus visual assets
conflict_or_disqualifier: Treating comparative vessels or one modern location as proven identification
acceptance_evidence: Supported forms; comparative limits; prohibited claims

minimum_qualification: Textile historian or costume researcher with early South Indian competence
evidence_access_required: Costume dossier, character arcs and storyboard assets
conflict_or_disqualifier: Using Bharatanatyam or imperial-Chola convention as default evidence
acceptance_evidence: Garment ranges; uncertainty; corrections by scene and asset

minimum_qualification: Animal-welfare specialist plus ritual historian, jointly if necessary
evidence_access_required: Aputhiran cow sequence and associated evidence
conflict_or_disqualifier: Normalising real animal distress or caricaturing a community
acceptance_evidence: No-harm requirements; contextual findings; production controls

minimum_qualification: Copyright or open-licensing adviser qualified for the relevant jurisdiction
evidence_access_required: Option B notices, contribution terms, source register and asset register
conflict_or_disqualifier: Assuming repository visibility grants reuse rights
preferred_review_mode: Written review of interim state and future options
acceptance_evidence: Owned/excluded layers; required corrections; jurisdiction and limitations
